arguments.argument: Java disk benchmark utility for read/write performance testing

set -e mapfile -t DEBS < <(find "${project.build.directory}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.deb" | sort) if [ "${#DEBS[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then echo "[patch] Expected exactly one .deb in ${project.build.directory}, found ${#DEBS[@]}" >&2 printf ' %s\n' "${DEBS[@]}" >&2 exit 1 fi DEB="${DEBS[0]}" WORK="${project.build.directory}/deb-repack" echo "[patch] Patching desktop entry in $DEB" rm -rf "$WORK" && mkdir -p "$WORK/pkg" dpkg-deb -R "$DEB" "$WORK/pkg" DESKTOP=$(find "$WORK/pkg/opt" -name "*.desktop" | grep -v runtime | head -1) if [ -n "$DESKTOP" ]; then sed -i 's|^Name=jdiskmark$|Name=JDiskMark|' "$DESKTOP" sed -i 's|^Categories=\(.*\)|GenericName=Disk Benchmark\nCategories=\1\nKeywords=disk;benchmark;performance;storage;speed;\nStartupWMClass=jdiskmark-App|' "$DESKTOP" echo "[patch] Result ($(basename $DESKTOP)):" cat "$DESKTOP" fi
# Inject bundled smartctl runtime (staged by linux-deb.yml before Maven runs). # --app-content is not reliable for the DEB format so we inject here instead. APP_CONTENT="${project.basedir}/src/main/app-content" if [ -d "$APP_CONTENT/smartctl" ]; then cp -r "$APP_CONTENT/smartctl" "$WORK/pkg/opt/jdiskmark/smartctl" chmod 755 "$WORK/pkg/opt/jdiskmark/smartctl/smartctl" echo "[patch] Injected smartctl: $($WORK/pkg/opt/jdiskmark/smartctl/smartctl --version 2>&1 | head -1)" else echo "[patch] WARNING: app-content/smartctl not found — skipping (slim build or local dev)" fi
# Copy the polkit policy file so postinst can install it from the package root. POLICY="${project.basedir}/src/main/jpackage-resources/net.jdiskmark.smartctl.policy" if [ -f "$POLICY" ]; then cp "$POLICY" "$WORK/pkg/opt/jdiskmark/net.jdiskmark.smartctl.policy" chmod 644 "$WORK/pkg/opt/jdiskmark/net.jdiskmark.smartctl.policy" echo "[patch] Included polkit policy file" fi
# Create a /usr/bin symlink so `jdiskmark` is on PATH. # Including it in the package contents makes it a dpkg-tracked file — # dpkg removes it automatically on uninstall, no prerm needed. mkdir -p "$WORK/pkg/usr/bin" ln -sf /opt/jdiskmark/bin/jdiskmark "$WORK/pkg/usr/bin/jdiskmark" echo "[patch] Created /usr/bin/jdiskmark symlink"
# Make xdg-desktop-menu failure non-fatal in postinst. # jpackage's generated postinst uses set -e, so xdg-desktop-menu failing # on headless systems (no display server) aborts the entire script. # Wrap the xdg-desktop-menu call with set +e/set -e so it can't kill the hook. POSTINST="$WORK/pkg/DEBIAN/postinst" if [ -f "$POSTINST" ] && grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*xdg-desktop-menu' "$POSTINST"; then sed -i -E 's|^([[:space:]]*)xdg-desktop-menu(.*)$|\1set +e; xdg-desktop-menu\2; set -e|' "$POSTINST" echo "[patch] Made xdg-desktop-menu non-fatal in postinst" fi
dpkg-deb -b "$WORK/pkg" "$DEB" echo "[patch] Done."
